readinessDefinitions.READY_FOR_CALIBRATION: Rights, provenance, source-family split, and truth basis are adequate for threshold fitting without using evaluation holdout data.
readinessDefinitions.READY_FOR_EVALUATION_ONLY: A bounded evaluation use is documented, but calibration, training, or commercial redistribution is not permitted or not scientifically independent.
readinessDefinitions.PROVENANCE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: A human or source custodian must confirm capture lineage, release, or truth before the record can be calibration data.
readinessDefinitions.RIGHTS_REVIEW_REQUIRED: One or more data, model, checkpoint, or commercial-use terms are not explicit enough for adoption.
readinessDefinitions.NOT_AVAILABLE: No registered local material or approved manifest was found.
readinessDefinitions.REJECT: The source is excluded because its use would violate a hard scientific, rights, privacy, or resource gate.
